title: A Villain's Will to Survive
description: The intermediate boss of an AAA game that the protagonist was developing is a villain destined to die in almost every possible route. When the protagonist suddenly becomes that villain, Deculein, he discovers that survival is nearly impossible. Knowing the character's predetermined fate, he must manipulate the game's events, become indispensable to the world, and find a way to twist the story so that the villain who was meant to die can survive.
author: Jee Gab Song
